sources.quote: Though all of the violations are still pending, meaning the agency has not resolved the issues, data from the past five years does not show any financial penalties associated with the alleged violations.

sources.quote: Officials from the Bay Area Air Quality Management District said Friday that Tesla, Inc., has agreed to pay a $1 million penalty and install a solar roof project to settle air quality violations at its Fremont factory.
sources.searcher_note: 2021 district settlement covering 33 notices of violation; a district enforcement resolution the lead's federal file does not show

notes: Heavy coverage of Tesla Fremont's air-district notices. Counts in press: 112+ since 2019 (district, June 2024), 369 in five years (SFGATE and others, June 2026), 374 over 2015-2025 with 328 pending (Richmondside, Jan 2026); lead says 356 since 2019. Press agrees on many notices and few or no penalties recently, but disagrees with 'no district enforcement order': a 2024 Hearing Board abatement order and a 2021 $1M settlement over 33 notices exist. Phillips 66 Rodeo's 320 pending notices appear in the Richmondside piece. No coverage found dated after 2026-06-30; newest items are 2026-06-10 (SFGATE, Drive Tesla Canada, Patch).
